skill_name: Edit the following short story to be suitable for young children.
workflow: The night was dark, but stars shone in the sky. The old man wandered through the forest, not sure where he was going. He heard a sound and was scared, so he stood behind a tall tree and peeked out. He soon spotted a small log cabin, brightly lit by a single lamp inside. The old man decided to go in and see if he was safe. To his surprise, an old woman was inside, waiting for him.
